calls.title: Two forestry courses still sit on AGRI under a parent on ENVR
calls.text: Open Asks Sheet 105 card 1: AGRI M10SY Forest Surveying and AGRI M1104 Introduction to Forest Operations are merged into Forest Ecology, which moved to ENVR on Sheet 104. The dry run that moves both to ENVR is committed; the session's permission check held its apply.
calls.no_reply: Both stay on AGRI, merged into an ENVR parent; nothing else waits on the card.

calls.title: Six curated anchor entries the re-key dry run cannot settle
calls.text: Three collide with other courses on their new Common SUBJ and need fresh numbers; three hospitality entries have no MQ discipline. On no reply they stay unapplied.

next_step.title: Save a person's common subject code for a held local code
next_step.text: The held view lists 416 local subject codes on which the pile mint holds 1,341 courses. Next, saving a person's choice from that view into the subject map by a committed change, and a session pass over the codes that read the same at every college using them.

changes.text: The held view, opened from a figure on the Subjects card, lists the local subject codes the pile mint holds on: 1,341 courses, 416 codes, 678 college-and-code pairs.
Both Subjects files rebuild in the daily build when their content changes; a failed step keeps yesterday's file and the publish goes on.

The Subjects card on the Commons front reads 16 colleges, 1,431 college-and-code pairs and 746 printed names; 753 of 1,625 codes get a common subject code from the existing files. Its builder is not in the daily build yet.
Curation step b, the local subject title, has an owner: the Courses bot drafts each title and a curator settles the ones that disagree. Sam left the call to the session on Nov 20.

The anchor re-key applied: 20 curated anchor entries onto their Common SUBJ, 15 keeping their number and 5 on the lowest free number of DIES or PARA; the three hospitality entries stay with the curator (#2938).
The anchor re-key dry run reads the anchor's era from its keys and applies only later maps: 2 re-keys, 15 prefix swaps, 6 for Sam (#2935).
A recorded note settles a weak mnemonic, and the anchor findings are their own re-key item, so nothing waits on a curator (#2857).
Saves read the sign-in at write time, and a lapsed sign-in says so
A row press edits the row and moves the panel; Check alignment audits a typed code
